apply_rope_inplace: apply RoPE in place to a 3D tensor using position and frequency tensors
apply_rope_approx_trigo: apply RoPE with approximate trigonometric functions for faster sin and cos computation
run_rope_kernel: run the Triton JIT rope_kernel to apply rotary positional embeddings on GPU tensors
review_rope_kernel: review the rope_kernel Triton JIT function for RoPE computation with configurable head group size
refactor_apply_rope: refactor apply_rope to support additional tensor shapes or frequency scaling schemes
